what_this_is: Every summer/October-2026 upstream Lean 4 kernel soundness report, with Clean's disposition and the path:line it rests on, so a new report cannot be forgotten and a disposition cannot rot. `scripts/check_upstream_soundness_intake.py` refuses a row whose evidence path:line does not resolve, a row whose non-null fixture is missing from the replay_forged ORDER, a row whose pinned oracle ACCEPTS the forgery (or a clean-accepts-live-hole row) whose `decision` names no DECISIONS.md heading, an undeclared disposition, a live hole filed below P0, and a not-affected row that was never measured. The checker reads the cited files as DATA (line count only); it mints no verdict from any source text, and no row here claims Clean refuses an exploit unless a named test measured it. Dispositions: `fixture` (a landed fixture a lane test runs Clean on); `ported` (Clean had the upstream behaviour on the re-check path, and the upstream guard is ported: a named test that was red at base and is green after pins it, and the evidence line is the guard; no exploit was published, so there is no fixture); `not-affected` (outside the kernel re-check path, or a cost bound rather than a False producer); `unmeasured` (Clean's behaviour on the vehicle was not measured; the evidence is the check source reading expects to bear on it, not proof it does); `clean-accepts-live-hole` (Clean was measured to admit the exploit: P0); `shared` (same class as another row or a dedicated item); `tracked`; `needs-owner-credential`.

rows.vehicle: `.proj S (2^64) c` stored in an .olean: a decoder that keeps a heap Nat's low limb reads `.proj S 0 c`, a different term that may be well typed
rows.oracle_verdict: v4.30.0-rc2 leanchecker REFUSES (rc 1, `(kernel) invalid projection`; --fresh the same), measured 2026-10-20
rows.note: Clean WAS measured to admit it (2026-10-20, release clean 0.9.0+g33ce84e20): per-constant-verify returned kernel_verified=1 for `forged_proj_idx : Nat := .proj Prod (2^64) (1, 1)`, and the sequential, --single-pass and --parallel stamp-verified modes all stamped it, because the two-phase .olean decoder (crates/clean-olean/src/expr.rs, the evidence line) read a heap index's low limb and a null or unreadable index as 0. `clean olean verify-batch --full-validation` (release 0.9.0+g24ba3725c, still the old decoder) loaded the module and checked none of it: constants_added 0, constants_skipped 88, tc_fail 0. `clean olean replay` refused it at load, with and without --fresh (`invalid compacted Nat MPZ header`: 2^64 is a two-limb MPZ object): the direct decoder (crates/clean-olean/src/import/convert_expr_direct.rs, parse_proj) already read the index exactly. R147 makes the two-phase decoder read it exactly too (read_kernel_nat_u64, whose canonical-form checks refuse a heap Nat below 2^63), and conversion keeps refusing anything above u32::MAX. Tests, red at base and green after: over_u64_projection_index_never_truncates_to_zero, null_projection_index_refuses_instead_of_inventing_zero and noncanonical_heap_projection_index_refuses (crates/clean-olean/src/expr/proj_tests.rs); the lane tests are crates/clean-mathverse/src/cli/replay_forged_lane_tests/proj_idx.rs. Not a False producer: the truncated term had to check against the stored type, so what Clean admitted was a different declaration from the one stored, not a proof of False.

rows.title: make the kernel is_prop check require a sort
rows.vehicle: is_prop returned false on a stuck (non-Sort) type-of-type; a data-field projection out of a stuck Prop-shaped carrier was then admitted, and False followed (Acc-trick P/Q stuck carrier)
rows.oracle_verdict: v4.30.0-rc2 leanchecker ACCEPTS; Clean REFUSES after the is_prop-requires-Sort guard (release lanes measured 2026-10-18, re-measured after the infer_proj move 2026-10-19)
rows.note: FIXED IN CLEAN (item kernel-defensive-invariants-v4331, guard (1)). Before the fix a release `clean olean replay --exact --json` on ReplayIsPropStuck reported ok:true, admitted 9, refusals [] (live hole, measured 2026-10-18); pinned leanchecker v4.30.0-rc2 ACCEPTS it too (axioms = #[]), so the differential oracle cannot catch it. The guard is `is_prop` using `ensure_sort` (the evidence line): on a stuck non-Sort type-of-type it now errors (TypeError::ExpectedSort) instead of answering Ok(false), so the data-field projection `IPK.observe` out of the stuck carrier is refused and `isprop_stuck_false : False` with it. Measured on the fixed release binary 2026-10-18: `clean olean replay` ok:false (IPK.observe refused `check_type: ExpectedSort`, admitted 7); every stamp-verified mode no longer stamps IPK.observe or isprop_stuck_false; the sharded worker refuses IPK.observe (`value does not check against declared type ... ExpectedSort`). per-constant-verify exercises it since R147, which removed two over-refusals of honest content that stopped the lane short of it: the walk registered the IPK.Owner family before IPK.gate was resident (`Invalid recursor IPK.Owner.rec`; honest control ReplayHonestSortDef), and it loaded the imported theorems IPK.b._proof_1/IPK.c._proof_1 without the values IPK.proposition's check unfolds (TypeMismatch, measured 2026-10-19). It now loads an imported Acc/WellFounded proof with its value (crates/clean-mathverse/src/cli/per_constant_wf_proofs.rs) and refuses IPK.observe at ExpectedSort, with isprop_stuck_false (docs/DECISIONS.md R147). Lane tests (release-only, the fixture's Init.WF closure is too slow in debug): crates/clean-olean/tests/replay_forged_lanes.rs (test_verify_batch_full_lanes_projection_needs_a_sort_typed_type), crates/clean-olean/src/replay_module/tests/is_prop_sort.rs, and crates/clean-mathverse/src/cli/replay_forged_lane_tests/is_prop_sort.rs. Battery arms: olean-replay-order and mathverse-replay-order. The pinned oracle stays vulnerable, so this keeps its R84 decision. Guards (2) and (3) of the item landed with R147 (rows 14632 and 14631); #15707's checked annotation stripping is not ported (row 15707, R147).
rows.arena: Kernel Arena Round 2026-09 test `bad/bugs/proj-of-subst-prop` (Zenodo record 22944094; vendored at crates/clean-olean/tests/fixtures/kernel_arena/round-2026-09/) is an independent vehicle of this class: `PR14806Subst.observe` projects a data field out of a proposition whose sort is stuck. Clean's NDJSON front door (`clean olean replay --from-export`) ACCEPTED it before the guard (release `clean_export_check` exit 0, the battery's first run, 2026-10-17); after merging the guard a release build rejects it (`check_type: ExpectedSort`, measured 2026-10-22). crates/clean-olean/tests/kernel_arena_battery.rs holds it as must-reject in a RELEASE run (its release mutation arm reverts the guard and must see a WRONG ACCEPT); a debug build stops on infer_type's debug-only invariant first (exit 2, a reviewed debug-only decline, never an accept), so a debug run cannot see the guard reverted. rows.note: PORTED by R147 in both checkers. clean-kernel: try_eta_struct_core's Prop guard (Guard 4) now asks the kernel's is_prop, which errors unless the type's type whnfs to a sort (R85); an error or a proposition leaves the major as it is. Before, it computed the type's type itself and expanded whenever that was not syntactically Prop, a stuck non-sort included. Test, red at base and green after: structure_eta_on_a_major_whose_type_is_not_sort_typed_stays_stuck (crates/clean-kernel/src/env/tests_v4331_invariants.rs:26). clean-ck0 (found by the R147 review, 2026-10-20): try_iota expanded every non-constructor major of a structure without inferring its type, so `fun h : And T U => And.rec (motive := fun _ => Bool) (fun _ _ => true) h` converted to `fun h => true`, which both pinned Lean tags refuse; and it left a CONSTANT major stuck, which Lean expands. major_admits_structure_eta (crates/clean-ck0/src/whnf.rs:244) is Lean's to_cnstr_when_structure: the major's type is headed by the structure and is not a proposition (zero up to normalization); a major that does not type leaves the recursor stuck. Tests, red at base and green after: structure_eta_at_iota_leaves_a_proof_major_stuck and structure_eta_at_iota_expands_a_constant_major (crates/clean-ck0/tests/structure_eta_iota_guard.rs).
